name: Corpus Search
description: Installs a workspace-isolated Markdown corpus search CLI and skill. Teams opt in manually; code auto-updates; uninstall preserves generated stores. Each workspace gets local BM25 retrieval and optional OpenAI-backed hybrid search and reranking through secure-fetch. Direct indexing requests flow into local setup without a disclaimer; source paths and external, destructive, or scheduled actions are confirmed at the point of use.
